title: ReNew Announces Results for the Second Quarter of Fiscal 2027 (Q2 FY27) and First Half of Fiscal 2027 (H1 FY27), both ended September 30, 2026
summary: November 2, 2026: ReNew Energy Global Plc (“ReNew” or “the Company”) (Nasdaq: RNW, RNWWW), a leading decarbonization solutions company, today ...
body_markdown:
**November 2, 2026:**


ReNew


Energy Global Plc (“


ReNew


” or “the Company”) (Nasdaq: RNW, RNWWW), a leading decarbonization solutions company, today announced its unaudited


consolidated


IFRS results for Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27.


**Operating Highlights:**


- As of September 30, 2026, the Company’s portfolio consisted of ~20.5 GW (including 1.7 GW/6.2 GWh of BESS). Additionally,


ReNew


has 6.4 GW of solar module and 2.5 GW of solar cell manufacturing capacities and is expanding its solar cells manufacturing capacity by another 4 GW, which is expected to


commence


commercial operations in Q4 FY27.


- The Company’s commissioned capacity has increased 19.5% year-over-year to ~13.7 GW (including 100 MW/250 MWh of BESS) as of September 30, 2026. Subsequently, the Company commissioned 112 MW of solar, increasing commissioned capacity as of date to ~13.8 GW, net of the 100 MW sold as part of our capital recycling strategy.


- Total Income (or total revenue) for H1 FY27 was INR 97,483 million (US$ 1,017 million), compared to INR 79,715 million (US$ 832 million) for H1 FY26. Net profit for H1 FY27 was INR 12,375 million (US$ 129 million) compared to INR 9,806 million (US$ 102 million) for H1 FY26. Adjusted EBITDA for H1 FY27 was INR 63,980 million (US$ 668 million), as against INR 53,459 million (US$ 558 million) for H1 FY26.


- Total Income (or total revenue) for Q2 FY27 was INR 49,619 million (US$ 518 million), compared to INR 38,557 million (US$ 402 million) for Q2 FY26. Net profit for Q2 FY27 was INR 6,422 million (US$ 67 million) compared to INR 4,675 million (US$ 49 million) for Q2 FY26. Adjusted EBITDA for Q2 FY27 was INR 33,588 million (US$ 350 million), as against INR 26,240 million (US$ 274 million) in Q2 FY26.


- Revenue from sale of power for H1 FY27 was INR 60,524 million (US$ 632 million) compared to INR 51,548 million (US$ 538 million) for H1 FY26. Revenue from sale of power for Q2 FY27 was INR 33,775 million (US$ 352 million), compared to INR 26,076 million (US$ 272 million) for Q2 FY26.


- Total income (or total revenue) for H1 FY27 includes external sales from our solar module and cell manufacturing operations amounting to INR 29,239 million (US$ 305 million) compared to INR 23,351 million (US$ 244 million) for H1 FY26. Net profit and Adjusted EBITDA for H1 FY27 from external sales from our solar module and cell manufacturing operations were INR 6,572 million (US$ 69 million) and INR 9,732 million (US$ 102 million) compared to INR 5,767 million (US$ 60 million) and INR 8,621 million (US$ 90 million) for H1


FY26


respectively.


- Total income (or total revenue) for Q2 FY27 from our solar module and cell manufacturing operations was INR 12,462 million (US$ 130 million) compared to INR 10,128 million (US$ 106 million) for Q2 FY26. Net profit and Adjusted EBITDA for Q2 FY27 from external sales from our solar module and cell manufacturing operations were INR 2,658 million (US$ 28 million) and INR 4,081 million (US$ 43 million) compared to INR 2,206 million (US$ 23 million) and INR 3,329 million (US$ 35 million) respectively for Q2 FY26.


****


**FY 27 Guidance**


The Company continues to expect to complete the construction of 1.6 to 2.4 GW by the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (“FY27”). The Company’s Adjusted EBITDA and Cash Flow to Equity guidance for FY27 are subject to weather and resource availability being


similar to


FY26. The Company continues to


anticipate


net gains from asset sales, which is part of ReNew’s capital recycling strategy, and has included INR 1–2 billion related to asset sales in the Adjusted


EBITDA. The Company continues to expect external sales from our module and cell manufacturing operations and has included INR 12–14 billion of Adjusted EBITDA against such sales in this guidance.
